scenarios.subject: high-school-basketball-gym
scenarios.description: An indoor high-school basketball game in a gym with spectator seating capacity of 1000. Actual attendance is 300 fans plus an assumed combined allowance of 30 players and coaches for the two teams: 330 occupants total. Model spectators seated or standing in bleachers with intermittent cheering, rather than treating spectators as continuously exercising athletes. Mechanical ventilation is operating; outdoor-air delivery, recirculation, filtration, floor area and room volume are unspecified and must be found or estimated for a comparable gym. Capacity alone does not determine gym dimensions or airflow. No masks. Use a two-hour reference game duration and a six-foot reference separation; these are evaluation coordinates, not assumed-safe answers. Model one continuously present infectious spectator, using an effective homogeneous breathing/activity approximation for the population. Calculate steady-background and initially clean-room transient outputs. The whole-room R_in criterion is 0.1 expected secondary transmissions, not a 10 percent individual infection probability.

conditions.well_mixed: Treat the room background concentration as spatially uniform outside the modeled local plume.
conditions.single_infectious_source: One infectious spectator remains present and emits at a constant effective rate.
conditions.uniform_breathing_and_masks: Use one effective breathing-flow parameter for emitter and recipients, with no masks; this is an explicit homogeneous approximation for spectators and team occupants.
conditions.continuous_unmasked_jet: Include the existing model's local continuous respiratory-jet contribution.
conditions.quasi_steady_local_plume: Treat the local plume as immediately established while the transient background concentration evolves.
conditions.stokes_particles: Use the existing effective spherical-particle settling model.

scenarios.basis: User scenario: a high-school basketball gym with capacity 1000 and 300 fans attending plus teams. Explicit illustrative choices added for this run: 30 players/coaches combined, two-hour reference duration, mechanical ventilation, no masks, one infectious spectator, initially clean transient air, six-foot reference separation, and whole-room R_in criterion 0.1. These define the conditional case; they are not empirical findings. Unknown room geometry, HVAC rates, and biological/activity parameters remain research inputs.
